limitations: Maize pilot only; no category approval or GPU timing.
Color shadows retain DoubleSide; shadowFront/depth/ground masks are separate gates.
Actual source growth/bridge shaders and web textures; indexed source isolates indexing from culling.
Candidate resource gates remain unchanged; rendered quality cannot waive triangle budget.
Only mature maize is derived; source bridges/states are retained and explicitly excluded from this pilot. State byte gate remains failed regardless of category dilution.
Leaf decimation changes geometry, UV interpolation and custom normal interpolation; quality remains untested.
Original core corners exact; each leaf label processed separately, no driver boundary merging.
Reduced leaf faces require new bridge mappings; old IDs must not be reused. No production GLB/runtime or bridge data changed.
No reversed faces added yet; projected all-leaf reversal counts do not establish orientation, coverage or GPU benefit.
